real_world_scenario.summary: Basement-adjacent excavation scenario applying 10-day adjoining-owner notice, survey/telltales, underpinning, 48-hour public-property restoration, trench-exit spacing, slope/geotechnical review, and nonstructural veneer support checks.
source_basis: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule XII Sections 1202 and 1203; refined markdown lines 3385-3446; raw PDF pages 186-189
